  • Bachelor of Science – Education – Field Endorsement in Special Education Generalist (Grades K-12)

Bachelor of Science – Education – Field Endorsement in Special Education Generalist (Grades K-12)

Students seeking a teaching endorsement in Special Education Generalist (K-12) are required to complete Professional Education courses, Endorsement courses, and their Essential Studies Program requirements. A student must maintain the required minimum GPA as determined by the Nebraska Department of Education (See Teacher Education Handbook for current GPA)

Professional Education Courses

A student must maintain the required minimum GPA as required by the Nebraska Department of Education (See Teacher Education Handbook for current GPA) No Professional Education course grade may be below a "C".
